title: LiveSync: Iterative Self-Training for Lip-Sync Generation
title_zh: LiveSync：面向唇形同步生成的迭代自训练方法

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出LiveSync迭代自训练框架，通过伪样本对生成与筛选优化音频驱动的唇形同步模型，在HDTF等数据集上达到领先同步效果并保持低推理延迟。 Audio-driven lip synchronization aims to match target speech through localized mouth and jaw articulation while preserving subject identity, head pose, and surrounding facial context. Naturally recorded videos provide synchronized reconstruction targets but rarely offer pairs that are matched in identity and pose yet differ primarily in speech-related articulation. Mask-based training enables reconstruction from these videos, but random-reference inputs differ from the aligned self-reference used at inference. We present LiveSync, an iterative self-training framework in which a single mask-based model generates pseudo pairs and is refined for deployment. The model is first trained on a curated real-video corpus augmented with externally generated clips covering under-represented visual conditions. A frozen checkpoint then uses independently sampled audio to generate mouth-edited references from real-video frames, copying pixels outside the edit mask from each source frame. After confidence filtering, these references are paired with aligned masked inputs and original real-frame targets. The retained pseudo pairs are mixed with real training data to refine the same model from its current weights, updating training supervision without adding inference stages. Although we instantiate the framework with a single-pass GAN-based model, the self-training strategy could in principle also be adapted to diffusion-based models. Experimental results show that LiveSync achieves leading synchronization performance on HDTF and competitive performance compared with the baselines on the AIGC-LipSync subset, while maintaining low inference latency.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出LiveSync迭代自训练框架，通过伪样本对生成与筛选优化音频驱动的唇形同步模型，在HDTF等数据集上达到领先同步效果并保持低推理延迟。 音频驱动的唇形同步旨在通过局部化的嘴部与下颌动作匹配目标语音，同时保留人物身份、头部姿态以及周围面部上下文。 自然录制的视频提供了同步的重建目标，但很少能提供身份与姿态匹配、而主要在语音相关动作上存在差异的样本对。 基于掩码的训练可以从这些视频中进行重建，但随机参考输入与推理时使用的对齐自参考并不一致。 我们提出LiveSync，这是一个迭代自训练框架，其中单个基于掩码的模型生成伪样本对并进行精炼以用于部署。 模型首先在一个精选的真实视频语料库上训练，并辅以外部生成的片段，以覆盖代表性不足的视觉条件。 随后，冻结的检查点使用独立采样的音频从真实视频帧生成经嘴部编辑的参考，从每个源帧复制编辑掩码之外的像素。 经过置信度筛选后，这些参考与对齐的掩码输入以及原始真实帧目标配对。 保留的伪样本对与真实训练数据混合，从模型当前权重出发对同一模型进行精炼，在不增加推理阶段的情况下更新训练监督。 尽管我们以单次前传的基于GAN的模型实例化该框架，但这一自训练策略原则上也可以适配基于扩散的模型。 实验结果表明，LiveSync在HDTF上取得了领先的同步性能，在AIGC-LipSync子集上相比基线方法具有竞争力，同时保持了较低的推理延迟。
